about.title: About Daily Calculations
about.metaDescription: Learn about Daily Calculations — free, fast, no-signup online calculators for mortgage, BMI, loan, GPA, and everyday decisions.
about.intro: Daily Calculations is a free collection of online calculators built for everyday decisions — no account required, no ads tracking you, just fast and accurate results.
about.missionBody: We believe useful tools should be accessible to everyone. Our goal is to make the math behind everyday decisions — mortgages, budgets, health metrics, unit conversions — simple and instant.
about.whatWeOfferBody: Over 40 calculators across finance, health, measurements, taxes, auto, and education. Each tool is designed to give you clear, instant results with no signup and no clutter.
about.whyFreeBody: Daily Calculations is supported by minimal, non-intrusive advertising. We will never require an account or sell your personal data to use any calculator on this site.
about.accuracyBody: Our calculators provide estimates based on the inputs you provide. Results are not financial, medical, tax, or legal advice. For important decisions, please review results with a qualified professional.
about.contactBody: Have a question, found a bug, or want to suggest a new calculator? Head to our Contact page — we read every message.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.metaDescription: Read the Daily Calculations privacy policy — what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights.
privacyPolicy.section1Body: Daily Calculations does not require you to create an account. We do not collect your name, email address, or any personally identifiable information unless you voluntarily submit it via the suggestion form. Calculator inputs are processed entirely in your browser and are never sent to our servers.
privacyPolicy.section2Body: We use privacy-respecting analytics to understand which calculators are most useful and how visitors navigate the site. This data is aggregated and anonymized — it cannot be used to identify you personally.
privacyPolicy.section3Body: We use a single cookie to remember your preferred color theme (light or dark mode). No tracking cookies or advertising cookies are set by Daily Calculations itself.
privacyPolicy.section4Body: We may use third-party services such as analytics providers. These services have their own privacy policies and may set their own cookies. We choose providers with strong privacy commitments and, where possible, configure them to minimize data collection.
privacyPolicy.section5Body: Since we collect minimal data, there is little to retain. Theme preference is stored in your browser's local storage and can be cleared at any time by clearing your browser data.
privacyPolicy.section6Body: You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of any personal data we hold about you. Because we collect almost no personal data, this right rarely applies — but if you have a concern, please contact us.
privacyPolicy.contactBody: If you have questions about this privacy policy, please open an issue on our GitHub repository or use the suggestion form on this site.

terms.section2Body: Daily Calculations provides free online calculator tools for informational and educational purposes. You may use the site for personal, non-commercial purposes. You agree not to misuse the service, attempt to disrupt it, or use it in any unlawful way.
terms.section3Body: Daily Calculations is provided 'as is' without warranties of any kind. We strive for accuracy, but calculator results are estimates only and may not reflect your specific situation. We do not guarantee that the site will be available at all times or that it will be error-free.
terms.section4Body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Daily Calculations and its operators are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the site or reliance on its results. Calculator outputs are not financial, medical, legal, or tax advice.
terms.section5Body: All content on Daily Calculations — including calculator logic, text, and design — is owned by or licensed to us. You may not reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works from our content without prior written permission.
terms.section6Body: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. We will indicate the date of the most recent update at the top of this page. Your continued use of the site after any changes constitutes your acceptance of the new terms.
terms.contactBody: Questions about these terms? Open an issue on our GitHub repository or use the suggestion form.

contact.title: Contact Us

contact.intro: We'd love to hear from you. Whether you've found a bug, want to suggest a new calculator, or just have a question — here's how to reach us.
